name: planning-workflows
description: Strict brainstorming, implementation planning, and systematic debugging workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Strict planning and systematic debugging workflows.
interface.longDescription: Routes new features through brainstorming, turns approved designs into detailed implementation plans, and investigates technical issues through systematic root-cause debugging. The plugin exposes no execution, TDD, review, worktree, or subagent workflows.
defaultPrompt: I have an idea for a feature I want to design.
Turn this approved design into an implementation plan.
Investigate this bug systematically before proposing a fix.
